changelog: FIX: Resolves Google Play Protect's 'harmful app' warning during install. The customer APK no longer requests the screen-recording / microphone permissions that the developer-only demo recorder needed — those permissions are now in the dev-only build flavor. Install will be clean again.
FIX: Player on-screen options (Audio / Subtitles / Speed / Aspect / Sleep / Info) — D-pad now actually moves focus inside the menu and OK selects.
FIX: Settings → 'My HushTV Canada License' subtitle now correctly shows $50 CAD / year.
FIX: Discovery hero shows hi-res TMDB backdrops again.
FIX: Parental Controls hide locked categories everywhere.
FIX: Speed Test screen fits on smaller TVs.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
